column1: # Real-data training matrix for KCL CREATE.
# One row = one Slurm array task = one (dataset, policy, cameras) training run.
# Submit with `bash hpc/submit_real.sh` on a CREATE login node; it filters these
# rows, checks each dataset is staged, snapshots what it submits, and groups the
# rows by wall time so a short cell does not queue behind a long reservation.
# Columns, whitespace-separated. `-` means "use the driver's default for this
# policy" (test/system/long_vla_real.sh). `extra` is the LAST column and may
# contain spaces: it is passed to lerobot-train verbatim, so any flag the driver
# does not name is still reachable from here.
#   dataset : directory name staged under $HF_LEROBOT_HOME/local/
#   policy  : act | diffusion | pi05
#   cameras : `all`, or a comma list of camera names with NO spaces
#             (central, wrist_camera_left, wrist_camera_right)
#   steps   : optimiser steps          (default: act 80000, diffusion 100000, pi05 30000)
#   batch   : batch size               (default: act 8, diffusion 32, pi05 8)
#   hours   : Slurm wall time, hours   (rows sharing a value share one array)
#   extra   : raw lerobot-train flags, or `-`
# The job builds a camera VIEW of the dataset for each distinct `cameras` value
# -- same episodes and actions, only the visible cameras differ -- and trains on
# that, so a row's run directory is named <dataset>__<camera slug>. Views cost a
# few MB each: they share the source's video files by symlink.
# Left out on purpose: short_fold (1 episode) and cube-dual-pnp (2 episodes) are
# smoke-sized, not training-sized -- use them with test/system/smoke_vla_real.sh.
# dataset            policy     cameras                          steps   batch  hours  extra
# --- camera ablation on cube-pnp-new: all three, central+left wrist, left wrist
cube-pnp-new         act        all                              80000   8      36     -
cube-pnp-new         act        central,wrist_camera_left        80000   8      36     -
cube-pnp-new         act        wrist_camera_left                80000   8      36     -
cube-pnp-new         diffusion  all                              100000  32     36     -
cube-pnp-new         diffusion  central,wrist_camera_left        100000  32     36     -
cube-pnp-new         diffusion  wrist_camera_left                100000  32     36     -
cube-pnp-new         pi05       all                              30000   8      36     -
cube-pnp-new         pi05       central,wrist_camera_left        30000   8      36     -
cube-pnp-new         pi05       wrist_camera_left                30000   8      36     -
# --- earlier datasets, trained on every camera
cube-pnp             act        all                              80000   8      24     -
cube-pnp             diffusion  all                              100000  32     24     -
cube-dual-pnp-new    act        all                              80000   8      36     -
cube-dual-pnp-new    diffusion  all                              100000  32     36     -
fold-short           act        all                              80000   8      36     -
fold-short           diffusion  all                              100000  32     36     -
